relations.subject: Johann Christoph Adelung
relations.evidence: educated at schools in Anklam and Berge Monastery, Magdeburg, and the University of Halle

relations.subject: Johann Christoph Adelung
relations.evidence: In 1759 he was appointed professor at the gymnasium of Erfurt, but relinquished this situation two years later

relations.subject: Johann Christoph Adelung
relations.evidence: In 1787 he received the appointment of principal librarian to the Elector of Saxony at Dresden, where he continued to reside until his death in 1806.

relations.subject: Johann Severin Vater
relations.evidence: The first volume, which contains the Asiatic languages, was published immediately after his death; the other two were issued under the superintendence of Johann Severin Vater (1771–1826).
